"""Launch the original matched data-distribution experiment after canonical-cache audit."""
import os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
import psutil,torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v1';plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
assert not (root/'launch-v1.json').exists() and not (root/'controller.claim').exists()
for name in ['data-cache-launch-v1.json','data-parent-flag-validation-launch-v1.json']:assert not live(read(root/name)['owner'])
validation=read(root/'data-parent-flag-validation-v1.json');assert validation['rows_checked']==171 and validation['different_rows']==171
assert read(root/'data-input-audit-v1.json')['new_masks_independently_computed']==171
assert read(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json')['returncode']==0
assert '288 passed in 4.58s' in (repo/'.cache/v168-data-CPU-regression-v1.log').read_text()
assert psutil.virtual_memory().available>52*2**30
save(root/'CPU-readiness-v1.json',{'status':'pass-data-audits-and-unchanged-neural-training-preflight',
 'tests':{'passed':288,'seconds':4.58,'new_data_tests':22,'new_data_seconds':.73,'log':ref(repo/'.cache/v168-data-CPU-regression-v1.log')},
 'data_plan':ref(root/'data-plan-v1.json'),'canonical_cache':plan['candidate_cache'],'data_audit':ref(root/'data-input-audit-v1.json'),
 'parent_flag_correction':ref(root/'data-parent-flag-validation-v1.json'),'actual_data_viewing':ref(root/'data-actual-viewing-v1.json'),
 'all90_neural_sources_unchanged':True,'expected_Adam_states':94,'expected_head_roots':5308,'expected_head_images':11368,
 'expected_total_parent_DINO_roots_each':342,'expected_total_parent_DINO_images_each':1368,
 'actual_parent_flag_maximum_difference_DN16':max(v['maximum_absolute_difference_DN16'] for v in validation['observations']),
 'exact_loss_optimizer_statement_bytes':[2737,4768],'expected_new_prediction_arrays':1644,'new_source_batches':171,
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_neural_forwards':0,'CUDA_initialized':torch.cuda.is_initialized()})
with (root/'controller-v1.log').open('x') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-P',plan['runner']['path'],'controller',str(root/'plan-v1.json')],
  cwd=repo,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",OMP_NUM_THREADS='2',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1'),
  stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
owner={'pid':p.pid,'created':psutil.Process(p.pid).create_time()}
save(root/'launch-v1.json',{'status':'original-matched-training-controller-launched','owner':owner,'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
 'plan':ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),'CPU_readiness':ref(root/'CPU-readiness-v1.json'),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print(owner,flush=True)
